subject: math
attribution: Practice items adapted from Virginia Department of Education released SOL tests.

questions.stem: If △ABC is similar to △ADE, then AB : AD =? : AE. Which replaces “?” to make the statement true?

George used decorative fencing to enclose his deck. Using the information below and assuming the top and bottom sides are parallel: A quadrilateral has one interior angle labeled x. Adjacent interior angles along one transversal are 130° and 50°. The top and bottom sides are parallel. What is the measure of ∠x?
Angle 1 is a complement of angle 2. If m∠1 = (14x − 8) and m∠2 = (8x + 6), what is the value of x and of m∠1?
In a figure, two parallel lines l and m are cut by a transversal t. Eight angles are formed and labeled 1 through 8 in standard order. Which pair of angles are alternate interior angles?

Lines BA and CD are intersected by a transversal, forming four angles labeled 1 through 4 at the top intersection and four angles labeled 5 through 8 at the bottom intersection. BA is parallel to CD if which condition is true?
In triangle XYZ, the measure of ∠YZV is 40° and the measure of ∠XYZ is 65°. Which of these angles must measure 40° in order for VR to be parallel to YZ?

Lines l and m contain the points shown below: Line l passes through (−3, 3) and (6, 0). Line m passes through (−5, 1). Which of the following points must lie on line m in order for lines l and m to be parallel?
Segment AB is horizontal. Point P lies above AB. Which point lies on the line through P perpendicular to AB?

Points A and B form a line segment. Points X, Y, Z, and W are arranged so that X and Z are directly above and below the midpoint of AB. Which pair of points determines the perpendicular bisector of line segment AB?
Which of the following groups of statements represents a valid argument?

choices.label: F
choices.text: Given: All squares have four sides. Conclusion: All quadrilaterals are squares.

choices.label: G
choices.text: Given: All rhombuses have congruent sides. Conclusion: All rhombuses are squares.

choices.label: H
choices.text: Given: All parallelograms have four sides. Conclusion: All parallelograms are quadrilaterals.

choices.label: J
choices.text: Given: All squares have angles. Conclusion: All rectangles are squares.

questions.stem: Which is the contrapositive of the statement, “If I am in Richmond, then I am in Virginia”?

choices.label: A
choices.text: If I am in Virginia, then I am in Richmond.

choices.label: B
choices.text: If I am not in Richmond, then I am not in Virginia.

choices.label: C
choices.text: If I am not in Virginia, then I am not in Richmond.

choices.label: D
choices.text: If I am not in Virginia, then I am in Richmond.

questions.stem: A surveyor measured along a river and formed a triangle with sides 40 ft, 80 ft, and 120 ft. What is the distance across the river from point A to point T?
From shortest to longest, the sides of △ABC are ordered based on opposite angle measures of 59°, 57°, and 64°. Which ordering is correct?
In a triangle, m∠C = 125° and m∠B = 35°. Which is the shortest side of the triangle?

On a map, Tannersville, Chadwick, and Barkersville form a triangle. Chadwick is 70 miles from Tannersville, and Barkersville is 90 miles from Tannersville. Which is a possible distance between Chadwick and Barkersville?
A circular design shows a 30° central angle and a chord length of 5 cm opposite that angle. How long is the radius of the circle?
A carpenter builds stairs that form a 30° angle with the floor. The vertical rise is 10 ft. What is the horizontal distance from the foot of the stairs to the wall?
The lengths of two consecutive sides of a parallelogram are 10 inches and 15 inches, and the included angle is 60°. To the nearest tenth of a square inch, what is the area of the parallelogram?
In quadrilateral KLMN, the interior angles are labeled 3x°, (x + 25)°, 95°, and 80°. What is the value of x?
Three vertices of a parallelogram have coordinates (0, 1), (3, 7), and (4, 4). What are the coordinates of the fourth-quadrant vertex?
Figure ABCDEF is a regular hexagon. Point Q lies at the center of the hexagon. What is the measure of ∠CDQ?
In pentagon ABCDE, m∠E = m∠C and m∠D = m∠B. The measures of ∠B and ∠C are given as 100° and 105°. What is the measure of ∠A?
Three adjacent angles around point B measure (19x − 15)°, (26x + 20)°, and (9x + 25)°. What is the measure of ∠ABD?
Triangle ABC is circumscribed about circle O. Points P and Q are points of tangency. BP = 3 and CQ = 5. What is the measure of BC?
In a circle, m∠CAB = 40°. What is m∠CDB?
AB is tangent to circle C at B. AB = 15 cm, and the radius of the circle is 8 cm. To the nearest tenth of a centimeter, what is the length of AC?
A stained-glass window is in the shape of a semicircle with a radius of 8 ft. Ignoring seams, how much glass is needed?
The cargo space of a truck is 2.44 m wide, 2.76 m high, and 8.20 m long. How many cubic meters of cargo space does the truck have?
What is the approximate volume of a can that is 5 inches tall and has a 2.5-inch diameter?
A rectangular prism tank measures 40 cm by 20 cm. The water level rises 0.4 cm when a rock is submerged. What is the volume of the rock?
The ratio between the volumes of two spheres is 27 to 8. What is the ratio between their radii?
A surveyor measures distances of 12 ft and 9 ft along one bank of a river and 52 ft along the opposite bank. Which is a good estimate of the distance across the river?
All vertices of a hexagon have integer coordinates. One line of symmetry passes through which two points?
Polygon A′B′C′D′E′ is obtained from polygon ABCDE by reflecting each point across the x-axis. Which transformation describes this change?
The midpoint of segment AB is (−2, 1). The coordinates of A are (2, 3). What are the coordinates of B?
An airplane travels due north at 300 knots. The wind blows from the east at 50 knots. Which is closest to the resultant speed of the airplane?
Which value for x is a counterexample to the following statement? For all positive values of x, x² > x.

The following information describes a Venn diagram showing lunch selections made by athletes. • A total of 310 athletes selected a sandwich. • A total of 125 athletes selected both a sandwich and a salad. • A total of 180 athletes selected both a sandwich and a soup. • The total number of athletes who selected a sandwich includes those who may also have selected salad, soup, or both. How many athletes selected a sandwich, a soup, and a salad?

The following information represents a Venn diagram of triangles. • One circle represents Acute Triangles. • One circle represents Isosceles Triangles. • The two circles overlap. Which statement is valid?

choices.label: A
choices.text: All triangles are acute and isosceles.

choices.label: B
choices.text: All triangles are either acute or isosceles.

choices.label: C
choices.text: No triangles are both acute and isosceles.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Some triangles are both acute and isosceles.

questions.stem: Lines j and k are cut by transversals m and n. Three angles are formed with the following measures: • One angle measures (x + y)°. • A corresponding angle on the same transversal measures (x + 30)°. • Another angle formed by the second transversal measures (3x − y − 60)°. Which relationship is sufficient to prove that j ∥ k?
The perimeter of triangle JKL is 200 centimeters. • JK = 68 centimeters • KL = 62 centimeters Which statement is true about the interior angles of triangle JKL?

choices.label: F
choices.text: m∠L is the greatest of the interior angles

choices.label: G
choices.text: m∠J is the least of the interior angles

choices.label: H
choices.text: m∠K is the greatest of the interior angles

choices.label: J
choices.text: m∠K is the least of the interior angles

questions.stem: Two triangles, △STW and △XYZ, are shown with corresponding side lengths expressed in terms of x. For △STW, the side lengths are: • ST = x + 5 • TW = 3x + 1 • SW = 3x − 1 For △XYZ, the corresponding side lengths are: • XY = 4x − 3 • YZ = 4x − 5 • XZ = 2x + 1 Which value of x makes △STW ≅ △XYZ?
The figure is a regular hexagon with each side measuring 4 inches. Points A, B, C, D, E, and F label consecutive vertices of the hexagon. What is the length of diagonal AC?

A shed is modeled as a combination of a triangular prism and a rectangular prism. A vertical plane intersects the model and is parallel to the front face of the shed. What is the shape of this cross section?
Using the same shed model, the following dimensions are given: • w = 12 feet • h = 6 feet What is the surface area of the exterior walls and doors of the shed?
Using the same shed model, if w = 12 feet, which equation correctly models the volume of the shed?
A cylinder has a volume of 300π cubic centimeters and a base with a circumference of 10π centimeters. What is the height of the cylinder?
The height of a rectangular prism is decreased by a factor of 1/4. The other dimensions are unchanged. Which statement is true?

choices.label: F
choices.text: The volume is decreased by a factor of 1/4.

choices.label: G
choices.text: The volume is decreased by a factor of 1/8.

choices.label: H
choices.text: The volume is decreased by a factor of 1/2.

choices.label: J
choices.text: The volume is decreased by a factor of 1/16.

questions.stem: A company makes two similar cylindrical containers. The total surface area of the smaller container is 0.81 times that of the larger container. The height of the larger container is 60 centimeters. What is the height of the smaller container?
Given quadrilateral ABCD with coordinates: A(0, 0), B(r, 0), C(r, m), D(0, m) Which expression proves that ABCD is a rectangle?

choices.label: F
choices.text: The length of each diagonal is √(r² + m²).

choices.label: G
choices.text: The common midpoint of the diagonals is (r/2, m/2).

choices.label: H
choices.text: The slope of AC is m/r and the slope of BD is −m/r.

choices.label: J
choices.text: The length of AB and CD is r, and the length of AD and BC is m.

questions.stem: A figure is composed of a regular pentagon attached to a rectangle along one side. Angles labeled x are the interior angles of the regular pentagon. What is the measure of each angle labeled x?
Points Q, R, and S lie on circle P. Angle QPS is a central angle measuring (x + 15)°. The intercepted arc QS measures 40°. What is the value of x?
In circle P, m∠HJK = 60°, and the measure of arc JK is twice the measure of arc HJ. What is the measure of arc HJ?
Circle P has a radius of 1 unit. A central angle of circle P measures 225°. What is the length of the minor arc?
The design for an arc-shaped stand is based on a 144° arc of a circle with a radius of 2.3 meters. What is the length of the arc, rounded to the nearest hundredth?

Three concentric circles share center O. • The radius of the smallest circle is r. • The radius of the middle circle is 2r. • The radius of the largest circle is 3r. • Segment KP, from the center to the outer circle, measures 42 inches. Which value is closest to the area of the shaded region between the middle and largest circles?
In circle T, the radius WP is 36 centimeters. A sector of the circle subtends a central angle of 65°. Which best represents the area of the shaded sector?
Circle W has center W(−4, 6) and radius 10 units. Which point lies on circle W?

A transversal line ℓ intersects four lines labeled a, b, c, and d. At line a, the angle formed with ℓ is 75°. At line b, the angle formed with ℓ is 85°. At line c, the angle formed with ℓ is 105°. At line d, the angle formed with ℓ is 100°. Which two lines are parallel?

Two parallel horizontal lines are cut by a transversal. At the upper intersection, angles are labeled 1 (upper left), 2 (upper right), 3 (lower left), and 4 (lower right). At the lower intersection, angles are labeled 5 (upper left), 6 (upper right), 7 (lower left), and 8 (lower right). ∠2 and ∠6 form which type of angle pair?
One exterior angle of a regular polygon measures 72°. What is the measure of one interior angle?

Lines a and b are parallel, and lines c and d are parallel. A transversal intersects all four lines, creating 16 angles numbered sequentially from top to bottom and left to right. ∠1 is at the top intersection on line a. Which angle is not necessarily congruent to ∠1?
A bench leg makes a 130° angle with the ground. The seat of the bench must be parallel to the ground. What must be the measure of angle x, the angle between the leg and the seat?

Line v is a transversal intersecting two lines, creating angles labeled w, x, y, and z. The measures shown are: one angle is 70°, another is 80°, another is 110°, and another is 100°, arranged so that w and x are adjacent on the upper line and y and z are adjacent on the lower line. Which statement is true?
Lines ℓ and m are parallel and cut by a transversal. At the top intersection, angles are labeled 1–4; at the middle intersection, 5–8; at the bottom intersection, 9–16. ∠4 and ∠12 are —
A board is nailed across two beams, forming eight angles labeled 1 through 8. Which equality of angle measures would ensure the beams are parallel?
Points C, A, B, K, L, M, N, and R lie on several connected segments forming a figure. Segment AB is shown. Which segment is congruent to AB?
A point A is not on line ℓ. Points W, X, Y, and Z are shown near line ℓ. Which point lies on the perpendicular to line ℓ drawn from point A?
A circular pie has center C. Points W, X, Y, and Z are on the circumference. Where should the pie be cut so that two boys receive equal shares?
If p → q and q → r, then —
The conditional statement “If you have a laptop, then you have a computer” is represented by p → q. What is the symbolic representation of “If you have a computer, then you do not have a laptop”?

V represents the set of all vehicles. M represents the set of all motorized vehicles. A represents the set of all automobiles. A is entirely inside M, and M is entirely inside V. Which conclusion is valid?

choices.label: H
choices.text: Some automobiles are not motorized vehicles.

questions.stem: Triangles IJK and LMN are shown with IJ = LM = 12 and IK = LN = 8. Which additional information would prove that △IJK ∼ △LMN?
Given: M is the midpoint of LN and KP. Which postulate or theorem is sufficient to prove △KML ≅ △PMN?
Which of the following could not be the lengths of the sides of a triangle?
In △DEF, DE = 8 in., EF = 6 in., and DF = 10 in. Which lists the angles in order from smallest to largest?
In △ABC, if m∠C < m∠B < m∠A, then —
A finish-line banner forms a right triangle with the ground. One side is 7 ft, another is 8 ft, and the support rope is the hypotenuse labeled x. Which is closest to the length of the support rope?
A baseball diamond is a square with side length 90 ft. What is the distance from home plate to second base?
What is the length of a diagonal brace for a wall 9 ft high and 12 ft long?
A parallelogram-shaped corral ABCD is adjacent to a shed. Angle at A is 40°. A gate CF swings from position CF to CG along the fence. Through how many degrees does the gate swing?
A diagonal of parallelogram DEFG forms two adjacent angles measuring 56° and 44° at vertex E. What is m∠DEF?
Quadrilateral MNOP is a parallelogram. M(1, 5), N(2, 1), O(−3, −2). If P has coordinates (x, 2), what is x?
Rectangular flowerbeds surround a fishpond shaped as a regular octagon. What is the measure of the angle between two consecutive flowerbeds?
A portion of a regular polygon is shown with each exterior angle measuring 24°. How many sides does the polygon have?
Each interior angle of a regular polygon measures 162°. How many sides does the polygon have?
In circle O, the measure of arc PSR is 280°. What is the measure of central angle ∠POR?
In trapezoid ABCD, bases AB and DC are parallel. AB = 26, DC = 40, one leg is 20, and the other leg is 2x + 6. What is the value of x?
In circle C, arc WX = 25°, arc XY = 40°, arc YZ = 25°, and chord WY = 24 cm. What is the length of chord XZ?
A pizza has a diameter of 16 inches and is divided into 6 equal slices. Which is closest to the area of one slice?
A solid is constructed from 1×1×1 cubes and is completely solid. What is the volume of the solid?
Which is closest to the volume of a sphere with radius 8 cm?
What is the total surface area of a rectangular prism measuring 5 ft by 1 ft by 1 ft?
Points P and Q are on one side of a lake, and points S and T are on the opposite side. PQ ∥ ST. Distances given are PQ = 30 m, PR = 28 m, and RT = 105 m. What is ST, the width of the lake?
The ratio of the perimeter of triangle U to triangle V is 1:2. The corresponding side lengths are labeled x, y, 2, 4, 5, and z. If the triangles are similar, what is x + y?
Right triangle ABC has side lengths 3, 4, and 5. What is the maximum number of lines of symmetry that can be drawn?
On a coordinate grid, point Q is at (−1, 2) and point V is at (1, −2). What is the slope of line QV?
One figure is mapped onto another by rotating all points 180° about the origin. Which transformation describes this?
Triangle ABC has vertices A(4, 5), B(5, 4), and C(1, 1). What is the midpoint of AB?
Rectangle ABCD has vertices A(2, 7), B(6, 7), C(6, 3), and D(2, 3). Which equation describes a line of symmetry?
Triangle ABC is reflected to form A′B′C′ across the line y = x. Which transformation produces A′B′C′?

choices.label: D
choices.text: reflecting ABC across the line y = x

questions.stem: A plumber bent a flexible joint to form an angle of 136°. Another pipe was attached so that points A, B, and D lie on a straight line (forming a straight angle of 180°). Angle x is the angle between the second pipe and the flexible joint, forming a linear pair with the 136° angle. What is the value of x?
Which pair of angles is supplementary (their measures add to 180°)?

Lines l and m are parallel. Line t intersects both lines, forming angles labeled ∠1 on line l and ∠2 on line m. Angle 1 and Angle 2 are on opposite sides of the transversal and outside the two parallel lines. Which best describes the relationship between ∠1 and ∠2?

A straight line l intersects four other lines w, x, y, and z. The angle formed between line l and line w is 110°. The angle between line l and line x is 65°. The angle between line l and line y is 75°. The angle between line l and line z is 115°. Which two lines are parallel?

Two horizontal lines a and b are cut by a transversal. At one intersection, the angle measure is (4x − 30)°. At the corresponding position on the other line, the angle measure is (2x)°. Which value of x will make line a parallel to line b?
Lines LM and QR are parallel. A transversal intersects LM at point N and QR at point P. Angles ∠M and ∠L are corresponding angles whose measures add to 60°. What is the measure of ∠QNP?
Two lines l and m are cut by a transversal. Angles are labeled x°, y°, z°, and w° at the intersections. Which additional piece of information would verify that l ∥ m?
Points R, S, Q, and T are shown. A line AB is given. One of the points lies on the line perpendicular to AB that also bisects AB. Which point lies on that perpendicular bisector?
Angle PQR is given. Points A, B, C, and D lie inside the angle. One point lies exactly on the angle bisector of ∠PQR. Which point lies on the bisector of ∠PQR?

A construction diagram shows arcs drawn from two points on a line that intersect above the line, forming the standard construction used to copy an angle. The drawing shows the arcs used to construct —

choices.label: A
choices.text: a bisector of a given angle

choices.label: B
choices.text: an angle congruent to a given angle

choices.label: C
choices.text: a bisector of a given line

choices.label: D
choices.text: a perpendicular to a given line at a point on the line

questions.stem: A diagram shows three overlapping sets labeled “cat owners,” “dog owners,” and “fish owners.” The overlap shows that dog owners and fish owners overlap, but cat owners do not overlap with fish owners. Based strictly on this information, which is a valid conclusion?

choices.label: A
choices.text: No cat owners also own dogs.

choices.label: B
choices.text: No dog owners also own fish.

choices.label: C
choices.text: No fish owners also own cats.

choices.label: D
choices.text: No pet owner owns more than one pet.

questions.stem: Consider the following statements: p: The sum of two angles is 90°. q: The two angles are complements. Which of the following is a symbolic representation of the statement: “If two angles are not complements, then the sum of the two angles is not 90°”?
Given: AD ≅ AC and AB ≅ AE. Points D and E lie on opposite sides of point A, forming triangles △ADB and △ACE. Which proportion is true?
Given: △LMQ ≅ △LNP. Which conclusion must be true?
In △PQR, the side lengths are: PQ = 56 mm, QR = 64 mm, PR = 70 mm. From smallest to largest, the angles of △PQR are —
Which set of lengths could not be the lengths of the sides of a triangle?
The locations of three water pumping stations form a triangle. Distance AB = 650 m Distance BC = 558 m Distance AC =? Which statement describes the possible length of AC?
The top of a ladder rests against a building 12 feet above the ground. The bottom of the ladder is 5 feet from the base of the building. What is the length of the ladder?

A design is formed by joining isosceles right triangles (45°–45°–90°) and 30°–60°–90° triangles. The hypotenuse of the 30°–60°–90° triangle is 12 cm. Which is closest to the length of one leg of the isosceles right triangle?
A circle has a diameter drawn horizontally. From one endpoint of the diameter, a radius is drawn making a 45° angle with the diameter. What is the diameter of the circle?
Quadrilateral ABCD is a parallelogram. Angle A measures 22°. What is the measure of ∠C?
The vertices of parallelogram ABCD have coordinates A(1, 8), B(4, 2), and C(−2, 7). What are the coordinates of D?
A piece of plywood is cut in a straight line from point C to point E to form a desktop. Which measurement would ensure that the desktop is rectangular?
Which of the following is not true about a parallelogram?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Any two opposite sides are congruent.

choices.label: B
choices.text: Any two opposite angles are congruent.

choices.label: D
choices.text: Any two consecutive angles are complementary.

questions.stem: A pentagon has five interior angles. Four of them measure 90°, 90°, 100°, and 105°. What is the value of the fifth interior angle x?
A regular polygon has a central angle x. Which is closest to the measure of x?
A regular polygon is shown. What is the measure of each interior angle?
In circle P, LO is a diameter. Points L, M, and O lie on the circle, forming triangle LMO. What is m∠LMO?
Two secants PB and PD intersect a circle at points A and C, respectively. PA = 5, AC = 4, and PB extends beyond the circle so that PB = 12. What is the length of PC?
In a circle, m∠RPQ = 50° and m∠PRQ = 60°. What is the measure of arc PR?
A tepee is shaped like a right cone with a slant height of 18.5 feet and a diameter of 20 feet. Approximately how much canvas is needed to cover the tepee (lateral surface area)?
The Great Pyramid at Giza has a square base with side length 230 meters and a height of 146.7 meters. Approximately what is the volume of the pyramid?
The ratio of the circumferences of two circles is 3:2. The radius of the smaller circle is 8 inches. What is the radius of the larger circle?
Two ships leave the same marina at the same time. After 2.5 hours, they are 3.2 miles apart. They continue traveling at the same speed and direction. How far apart will they be 2 hours later?
Triangle XYZ is obtained from triangle ABC by a rotation about point P. The rotation is 90° clockwise about the origin. Which of the following indicates the correspondence of the vertices?

choices.label: F
choices.text: A → X, B → Y, C → Z

choices.label: G
choices.text: A → Y, B → Z, C → X

choices.label: H
choices.text: A → X, B → Z, C → Y

choices.label: J
choices.text: A → Z, B → X, C → Y

questions.stem: A figure on a coordinate plane is symmetric left-to-right across the y-axis but not symmetric across the x-axis. This figure is apparently symmetric with respect to —

choices.label: C
choices.text: both the x-axis and the y-axis

choices.label: D
choices.text: neither the x-axis nor the y-axis

questions.stem: A line is graphed on a coordinate plane. It rises 1 unit for every 3 units it moves to the right. What is the most likely slope of the line?
Lines ℓ and m are cut by transversal n. Which statement would prove that ℓ ∥ m?
Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. If the measure of ∠1 is 115°, what is the measure of the corresponding interior angle on the same side of the transversal?

A construction shows a line segment with two arcs drawn from each endpoint intersecting above and below the segment, followed by a straight line drawn through the arc intersections. Which construction is illustrated?

choices.label: F
choices.text: An angle congruent to a given angle

choices.label: G
choices.text: The bisector of a given angle

choices.label: H
choices.text: The bisector of a given segment

choices.label: J
choices.text: The perpendicular bisector of a given segment

questions.stem: A regular polygon has equal sides and equal interior angles. Each exterior angle measures 60°, and each interior angle is supplementary to its exterior angle. What are the measures of x and y, where x is the exterior angle and y is the interior angle?
What is the converse of the following statement? “If Joe goes fishing, then he needs bait.”

choices.label: A
choices.text: If he needs bait, then Joe goes fishing.

choices.label: B
choices.text: If Joe does not go fishing, then he does not need bait.

choices.label: C
choices.text: If he does not need bait, then Joe does not go fishing.

choices.label: D
choices.text: If Joe goes fishing, then he does not need bait.

questions.stem: Let p represent “x² = 21” and let q represent “x is not a whole number.” Which represents the statement: “If x is a whole number, then x² ≠ 21”?
Which pipe lengths could be joined to form a triangle?

Joseph is standing 12 feet from a mirror lying flat on the ground. His eyes are 5 feet above the ground. The mirror creates congruent angles of incidence and reflection. A building is 264 feet from the mirror. Which is closest to the height of the building?
In triangle ABC, ∠A = 60° and ∠B = 50°. Which best describes the possible length of side BC relative to sides AB and AC?
The following relationships are shown: Some flowering plants are bushes. Roses are a type of flowering plant. Which statement must be true?

choices.label: H
choices.text: Some roses are not flowering plants.

questions.stem: From a point 12 feet from the base of a building, the angle of elevation to the top is 70°. Given: sin 70° = 0.940 cos 70° = 0.342 tan 70° = 2.75 Which is closest to the height of the building?
Two squares share a vertex. Square ABCD has diagonal AC = 28 mm. Square DECF is congruent to ABCD. What is the perimeter of square DECF?
The opposite sides of a window frame are congruent. Which additional information would verify that the frame is a rectangle?
In parallelogram WXYZ, W = (−2, 6), X = (6, 6), Y = (9, 1), and Z = (1, 1). What are the coordinates of the point of intersection of diagonals WY and ZX?
For a regular polygon with three sides, each interior angle has a measure of —
Each interior angle of a regular polygon measures 156°. How many sides does the polygon have?
In parallelogram ABCD, m∠A = 4x° and m∠B = 8x°. If x = 5, what is m∠D?
A concrete pillar is shaped as a rectangular prism with dimensions 9.5 m by 1.5 m by 15 m. Which is closest to the volume of concrete needed?
A right triangular pyramid has a height of 10 inches and a base area of 41.57 square inches. What is the volume, in cubic inches, of the pyramid?
The surface area of a plastic ball is 196π. A sponge ball has a radius twice that of the plastic ball. What is the surface area of the sponge ball?
The diameter of a circle has endpoints (−3, 2) and (3, −2). Which is closest to the length of the diameter?
What are the most likely coordinates of R′ if segment R′S′ is a reflection of RS across the y-axis and R is at (−4, 3)?
A line segment has one endpoint at (3, 2). If the midpoint is (6, −2), what are the coordinates of the other endpoint?
A ladder is leaning against a vertical house. The angle between the ladder and the vertical side of the house is 38°. What is the measure of the angle between the ladder and the ground?
Two lines, AB and CD, intersect at point P. Segment PR is perpendicular to line AB. The measure of ∠APD is 170°. What is the measure of ∠DPB?
In triangle ABC, sides BC and AC are extended to form two sides of parallelogram CDEF. The measures of ∠CAB and ∠CBA are each 36°. What is the measure of ∠CFE?
Line a is parallel to line b. Which condition proves the lines are parallel?
Triangle ABC is a right triangle with the right angle at C. Which are possible measures for angles A and B?
If negotiations fail, the baseball strike will not end. If the baseball strike does not end, the World Series will not be played. Which conclusion logically follows?

choices.label: A
choices.text: If the baseball strike ends, the World Series will be played.

choices.label: B

questions.stem: A rope is attached to a boat 7 feet below the level of a dock-mounted windlass. When the rope length is 25 feet, the rope and vertical drop form a right triangle. What is the horizontal distance from the boat to the dock?

How many lines of symmetry does a square have?

choices.label: D
